description: This file defines the OAuthServer class, which manages OAuth2 authorization server functionality, including token issuance, grants, and repository setup within the OrangeHRM human resource management system.

classes.name: OAuthServer
classes.description: Manages OAuth2 server setup, grant types, and token repositories, providing methods to initialize and access the authorization server and token TTL configurations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes repositories, keys, and token TTL settings from configuration.

methods.name: getServer
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of AuthorizationServer, configuring OAuth2 grants and repositories if not already initialized.

methods.name: getAuthCodeTTL
methods.description: Returns the configured expiration interval for authorization codes.

methods.name: getRefreshTokenTTL
methods.description: Returns the configured expiration interval for refresh tokens.

methods.name: getAccessTokenTTL
methods.description: Returns the configured expiration interval for access tokens.
